#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long modpow(long long base, long long exp, const int MOD = 1000000007) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    int components;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0), components(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int u) {
        if (parent[u] != u) parent[u] = find(parent[u]);
        return parent[u];
    }
    void unite(int u, int v) {
        u = find(u);
        v = find(v);
        if (u != v) {
            if (rank[u] < rank[v]) swap(u, v);
            parent[v] = u;
            if (rank[u] == rank[v]) ++rank[u];
            --components;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    vector<bool> visited(p, false);
    DSU d(p);
    for (long long i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        for (long long j = i; !visited[j]; j = (j * k) % p) {
            visited[j] = true;
            d.unite(i, j);
        }
    }
    int c = d.components;
    if (k != 1) c--;
    cout << modpow(p, c) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
